allowlist.reason: Evaluation case files: recorded task statements and expected verdicts an evaluation replays verbatim; editing them changes what the evaluation measures.
Held-out evaluation case files: recorded task statements kept apart from tuning and replayed verbatim; editing them changes what the evaluation measures.
Generic evaluation case files: recorded task statements the generic suites replay verbatim.
Recorded evaluation suite files: captured runs, facts and registries the process evaluations read as recorded.
The failure-taxonomy bundle: real failures captured from past runs, quoted as they happened.
Recorded agent-stream fixtures: agent output captured byte for byte, which parsers are tested against as it was emitted.
Recorded pull-request-body fixtures: bodies captured from the forge as opened, which the body parsers must keep reading.
Recorded pull-request-body fixtures: bodies captured from the forge, which the body parsers must keep reading.
Recorded pull-request-body fixtures: forge responses captured as returned, bodies included.
Decision records: immutable once accepted; they quote the names in use when each decision was taken.
Changelogs: released entries are never rewritten.
The lockfile: its hits are base64 sha512 integrity strings, which the package manager writes and nobody edits.
A fixture file named after a tranche slug: its path is the input the coherence check is tested on.
A fixture file named after a tranche slug: its path is the input the token report is tested on.
A fixture file named after a tranche slug: its path is the input the task-contract parser is tested on.
The guard's own files: the check, its tests and this data file must spell the token they count.
The one legacy-spelling module: it reads markers written under the old prefix, so it must spell that prefix.
The retired-name prose rule: it must spell the word it bans.
Recorded Issue-body fixtures: task Issue bodies captured from the forge as cut, which the Issue and brief parsers must keep reading.
Configuration golden files: the configuration surface recorded as it was emitted, which the configuration tests compare against as recorded.
A recorded architecture-invariants fixture: the review loop's module layout captured as it stood, which the architecture test compares against.
A recorded projects-registry fixture: a projects file captured with historical tranche slugs, which the registry parser is tested on.
A recorded documentation-owners fixture: an owners file captured with historical bindings, which the owners reader is tested on.

The CI-impact replay record: `scripts/ci/replay.ts` applies each case to a pinned base commit at which the retired workspace packages still exist, so its paths and package names must stay as they were at that commit.
